questions.category: Describe Azure Architecture and Services > Describe Azure networking services
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Azure DNS
questions.question: Which statement best describes Azure DNS?

options.text: A DNS zone used for custom private name resolution within Azure virtual networks
